♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through Taurus in your 2nd house, in Krittika and then Rohini, putting a steady but sensual light on your resources and self-worth. With the Sun in Libra in your 7th, retrograde Mercury and Venus also in Libra, and fiery Mars in Leo aspecting your 11th, your energy is pulled between material security and the balance of your key relationships and alliances. Retrograde Saturn in Pisces continues to work quietly in your 12th, asking you to trim hidden drains on your time and spirit. You’re motivated but also selectively stubborn—great for sticking with what matters, less great for clinging to what’s outdated.

💼 Career: The Taurus Moon in your 2nd favors consistent effort over heroic last-minute pushes. This is a practical day for stabilizing income streams, tightening processes around billing, and attaching solid value to your skills. Sun–Mercury–Venus clustered in your 7th highlight client relations, partnerships and negotiations; an old proposal or collaboration could return, but the terms likely need rebalancing. With Mars energizing your 5th/11th axis, you can take a bolder stance in group settings—offering leadership on a project or owning your creative contribution more openly. Just avoid impulsive promises about money or timelines; let the Moon’s earthy caution check your fire.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes revolve around fairness and reciprocity. The Libra stellium in your 7th house puts a spotlight on how your needs and your partner’s needs are weighed. If attached, you may feel ready to renegotiate something that has quietly bothered you—who compromises more, who takes on certain emotional or practical loads. The Taurus Moon asks: does this bond actually help you feel secure in your body, not just in your mind? If single, your magnetism is strong in one‑to‑one spaces, but you’re less interested in drama and more drawn to people who show reliability in small ways—how they keep time, follow through, and handle tension.

💰 Money: With the Moon in your 2nd and Venus in your 7th, money talks can be productive if handled calmly. This is a good day to revisit shared expenses, service rates, or agreements with collaborators and partners. Retrograde Mercury encourages you to look for small leaks—discounts you give too easily, unpaid invoices, or arrangements that rely more on goodwill than clarity. Mars in Leo can tempt you into status spending; choose one meaningful purchase over scattered splurges meant to impress.

🧘 Advice: Before you say yes to any new commitment, pause and ask: “Does this genuinely support my stability or just my ego?” Let the answer shape your day.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your courage serves your long-term security instead of your momentary pride, your fire stops burning you and starts lighting your way.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon traveling through your own sign, in Krittika and Rohini, turns up the volume on your feelings, body awareness and preferences. With Sun, retrograde Mercury and Venus all in Libra activating your 6th house, and Mars in Leo energizing your 4th, today is about how you actually live in your own skin and in your own space. Retrograde Saturn in Pisces in your 11th presses you to refine long-term goals and question which communities truly support you. You’re both softer and stronger than usual—sensitive to atmosphere, yet ready to quietly plant your feet.

💼 Career: The Moon in your 1st makes you more visible, even if you’re not seeking the spotlight. Others pick up on your mood and your standards. The Libra 6th-house stellium brings focus to workflows, obligations and how fair your daily exchanges are. You might see clearly where you’ve been over-accommodating—doing extra emotional or practical labor that never makes it into anyone’s job description. Mars in your 4th can stir restlessness around your home or base of operations; changes in your workspace, schedule, or remote-work setup can have outsized impact on productivity. Prioritize one structural improvement rather than trying to reorganize everything.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in your sign, your desire for affection, touch and emotional steadiness is strong. If partnered, you may want more tangible proof of care—help with chores, a thoughtful gesture, or unhurried time together. The Libra planets in your 6th favor shared routines: cooking together, planning health or fitness steps, or gently rebalancing who handles which daily tasks. If single, you may draw interest simply by being grounded and genuine. Someone in your everyday environment—a coworker, neighbor, or fellow regular—could feel more noticeable today.

💰 Money: Taurus Moon days highlight your relationship to comfort and resources. You may feel inspired to invest in quality items that make daily life smoother: tools, organization systems, or health-supporting purchases. The 6th-house Libra stellium is ideal for reviewing work-related earnings, benefits or freelance structures—does what you’re paid accurately reflect the effort and care you bring? Saturn in your 11th suggests re‑evaluating group expenses or subscriptions; some may no longer match your evolving priorities.

🧘 Advice: Tune into your body as you move through decisions: tension, ease, tightness in the chest or jaw. Your physical responses today are reliable feedback about what’s truly right for you.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop negotiating against your own comfort, life quietly arranges itself around your true value.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon moving through Taurus in your 12th house, much of your energy turns inward, even if life looks busy from the outside. Sun, retrograde Mercury and Venus in Libra light up your 5th house of joy, creativity and romance, while Mars in Leo stimulates your 3rd, making your mind quick and your tongue sharp. Retrograde Saturn in your 10th asks for maturity in public and professional choices. Today has a paradoxical feel: private processing on the inside, playful or expressive impulses on the outside.

💼 Career: The 12th-house Moon favors behind-the-scenes work—research, planning, cleanup and quiet problem-solving. You may prefer to close your door or put on headphones to actually get things done. Meanwhile, the Libra 5th-house stellium boosts your creative output: presentations, design work, teaching, or anything requiring aesthetic sense benefits from your touch. Mars in your 3rd supports persuasive communication, but also raises the risk of sounding impatient. Use your verbal fire to clarify, not to cut down. This is a strong day to refine a creative project before presenting it more widely later in the week.

❤️ Love: With your 5th house lit, your romantic and playful side is activated, even as the Moon keeps you somewhat introspective. If partnered, you may crave both affection and pockets of solitude. Shared artistic activities, games, or light-hearted dates can help you reconnect without heavy talk. If single, you might feel drawn to someone who appreciates both your wit and your depth—someone you can laugh with, but also share your quieter concerns. Because the Moon is in your 12th, be mindful of falling into fantasies about someone’s potential; stay curious about who they actually are right now.

💰 Money: The Taurus Moon can bring attention to subtle financial drains—subscriptions you don’t use, small recurring costs, or emotional spending done in private. This is a good day to quietly review accounts without announcing big changes yet. The Libra planets in your 5th may tempt you toward spending on pleasure, entertainment or children. Choosing one planned indulgence instead of scattered, unconscious purchases will feel better. Saturn in your 10th supports long-term career investments—courses, tools or mentoring that strengthen your professional backbone.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself at least one unstructured pocket of time today, even if it’s short. Your nervous system needs space to file everything it’s been taking in.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you honor your need to retreat as much as your need to connect, your brilliance stops short-circuiting itself.

leo:

scorpio:
